value.note: The paper is a macroeconomic policy-mix game with a reduced-form probabilistic-voting election probability, plus UK popularity regressions. Its main object is how central bank interest-rate policy affects electoral chances, not a voting procedure or the strategic or computational aspects of one.

C0.reason: The voting procedure is only a reduced-form input to a monetary-policy game and an empirical popularity study, so its main object is not a voting procedure or its strategic or computational aspects.
